I'll compute C(51, 12) and calculate the sum of its decimal digits using code.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate C(51, 12)
n = 51
k = 12
binomial = math.comb(n, k)
print(f"C({n}, {k}) = {binomial}")

# Calculate sum of decimal digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in str(binomial))
print(f"Sum of decimal digits: {digit_sum}")

# Verify the digits
digits_list = [int(d) for d in str(binomial)]
print(f"Digits: {digits_list}")
print(f"Verification: {' + '.join(str(d) for d in digits_list)} = {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
